aiSummary: Most complaints this week center on packaging seals and delivery-day shelf life. Taste and quality feedback stayed strongly positive, especially for the toned milk and paneer lines. Recommend inspecting the TP-4 sealing head and reviewing cold-chain handling on the eastern delivery route.

entries.text: The paneer packet had a small tear on arrival, seal wasn't fully intact.
Toned milk tastes fresh and consistent, been buying for 3 years now.
Curd turned slightly sour a day before the printed expiry date.
Delivery crate wasn't cold enough this morning, milk was lukewarm.
Ghee aroma and texture are excellent this batch, best in a while.
Full cream milk pouch leaked slightly at the corner seal.
Consistent quality across the week, no complaints at all.
Packet date printing was smudged and hard to read.
Milk was noticeably watery compared to last month's batch.
Great taste, kids love the toned milk with breakfast cereal.
